kebab_example: aliyun ice list-ai-agent-dialogues --session-id f27f9b9be28642a88e180000 --round-limit 5 --start-time 0 --end-time 17358082464030 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --order DESC --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAIAgentDialogues

parameters.help_en: The number of most recent dialogue rounds to return. This value must be a positive integer. This parameter is mutually exclusive with pagination parameters; if specified, it overrides them
parameters.help_zh: 对话回合限制。指定返回最近N个回合的对话记录，必须为正整数。与分页参数互斥，使用此参数时将忽略分页参数
parameters.name: round_limit

parameters.help_en: The start Unix timestamp (inclusive), in milliseconds
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end Unix timestamp (inclusive), in milliseconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of items per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: `ASC` (ascending) and `DESC` (descending). Default value: `DESC`
parameters.name: order

AttachedFileList.description_en: A list of file attachments referenced in the dialogue
AttachedFileList.description_zh: 附件列表。对话中引用的文件附件信息

Format.description_en: The format of the attachment, such as mp3, wav, or pdf
Format.description_zh: 附件的格式（如 mp3、wav、pdf 等）

Id.description_en: The unique identifier of the attachment

Name.description_en: The file name of the attachment

Type.description_en: The attachment type, represented by a numeric value. The meaning of this value is defined by your business logic
Type.description_zh: 附件类型。数值类型，具体含义由业务定义

DialogueId.description_en: The unique ID of the dialogue

Extend.description_en: A JSON-formatted string for extended information. Use this field to store custom data, such as sentiment labels or intent recognition results
Extend.description_zh: 扩展信息。JSON 格式的扩展字段，用于存储额外的自定义数据，如情感标签、意图识别结果等

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the workflow node that generated the dialogue entry, which you can use for tracing
NodeId.description_zh: 节点 ID。标识生成该对话的流程节点，用于追溯对话是由哪个处理节点产生的

Producer.description_en:
The producer of this message.

user: A message from the user.

agent: A message from the agent
Producer.description_zh:
这句话的产生者。

user： 用户产生的句子

agent：智能体产生的句子

ReasoningText.description_en: The agent's reasoning text, which can reveal its thought process

RoundId.description_en: The ID of the dialogue round

Source.description_en:
The source channel of the message. Valid values:

chat: The message is from a text chat.

call: The message is from a voice call
Source.description_zh:
这句话的来源。可选：

chat 文本对话

call 语音通话

Text.description_en: The text content of the dialogue entry

Time.description_en: The Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) when the dialogue entry was created
Time.description_zh: 这条对话产生的Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

Type.description_en:
The type of the message. Valid values include:

For a call:

greeting: A welcome message.

normal: A standard voice response.

speech: A proactive voice broadcast.

For a chat:

normal: A standard text response.

announcement: A proactive text push.

custom: A custom message
Type.description_zh:
这句话的类型。可选：

语音通话
greeting 欢迎语
normal 语音回复
speech 主动播报

文本对话
normal 文本回复
announcement 主动推送文字。
custom 自定义消息
